title: Main Aapki Zehra Hun Baba
body:
Qabre Nabi Pa Fatema Zehra Ka Bain Tha
Baba Tumhare Samne Beti Ko Chain Tha
Jalta Hua Jo Mujh Pa Gira Dar Me Jal Gayi
Itne Sitam Huye Meri Surat Badal Gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Pehchaan Lo Apni Beti Ko, Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba
18 Baras Wali Dekho, Main Pehli Zaeefa Hoon Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Do Pasliyaan Meri Toot Gayi, Hoti Hai Azeeyat Seene Mein
Aur Saans Kabhi Aate Aate Ruk Jaati Hai Mere Seene
Har Saans Bahut Tadpati Hai, Is Tarah Main Zinda Hoon Baba
Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis Waqt Ali Aajate Hain, Jazbaat Daba Kar Rakhti Hoon
Jo Ungliyaan Meri Toot Gayi, Un Sabko Chhupa Kar Rakhti Hoon
Ehsaas Nahi Hone Deti, Pehlu Se Shikasta Hoon Baba
Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Darwaza Gira Sar Par Jab Se, Kuch Mujhko Nazar Aata Hai Nahi
Tooti Hai Kamar Is Tarah Meri, Ab Khud Se Chala Jaata Hai Nahi
Uthti Hoon Asa Lekar Aksar, Is Darja Zaeefa Hoon Baba
Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis Dar Par Farishte Aate The, Us Dar Ko Jalaya Hai Haaye
Mohsin Bhi Shikam Mein Maara Gaya, Ye Zulm Bhi Dhaaya Hai Haaye
Mere Dard Ke Behte Dariya Mein, Zakhmon Ka Safeena Hoon Baba
Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Takleef Hai Ye Bhi Ummat Ne Aawaazein Uthaayin, Rone Par
Paabandiyan Jitni Mumkin Thi, Woh Sab Lagaaein Rone Par
Jo Baap Ka Matam Kar Na Saki, Main Aisi Yateema Hoon Baba
Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Pehchaan Nahi Paoge Meri, Aankhon Mein Kaha Beenayi Hai
Hen Jhurriyaan Mere Chehre Par, Baalon Pe Safedi Chhaayi Hai
Main Lakht-e-Jigar To Aapki Thi, Ab Gham Ka Khazeena Hoon Baba
Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Mar Kar Bhi Nahi Qismat Mein Sukun, Roze Ko Bhi Mere Tod Diya
Din Mein Hai Musalsal Dhoop Yahan, Aur Shab Mein Bahut Hai Sannata
Ummat Ne Sitam Kab Roke Hain, Main Aaj Bhi Nishana Hoon Baba
Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Firdous Ki Shehzadi Bhi Khaali, Ye Ujdi Lehad Mein Rehti Hai
Baba Hai Payambar Aur Uski Beti Ye Museebat Sehti Hai
Ye Saare Musalmaan Bhool Gaye, Main Aapka Tukda Hoon Baba
Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Ayyame Aza-e-Zehra Hain, Abbas Yehi Gham Hota Rahe
Aur Saath Mein Akbar, Zehra Ke Mohsin Ka Bhi Matam Hota Rahe
Har Ghar Se Sadaayein Aati Rahein, Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba
Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba
